title: player.pos
description: The hidden player's cell. Sent at each step start (target cell) and on non-step changes.

kind.description: FA0 (FIELD_MECHANICS_AUDIT_PLAN): ice (a slide on an ice tile, one message per cell) is optional and sent by no adapter before FA8; a client that doesn't know a kind follows it as a forced move.

frames.description: How long the move takes; 0 for an instant change.

n.description: The move.step this answers, if any.
